report.description: BLOCK: training_event_coverage, policy_changed, butter_pickup_gain, butter_delivery_present, wood_stick_navigation, burning_match_route_avoidance, burning_match_forced_escape, composite_performance, matched_ablation_advantage, temporal_dynamics, runtime_replay_lineage

gates.name: training_event_coverage
gates.threshold: every stage reaches its predeclared event-sample mastery threshold within bounded budget and every critical ecology sensor channel activates

gates.name: paired_action_sensitivity
gates.threshold: food, obstacle and heat paired swaps each change code and motor turn

gates.name: policy_changed
gates.threshold: learned policy fingerprint differs from initial

gates.name: butter_pickup_gain
gates.threshold: butter pickups exceed cold/no-optimize in aggregate and occur on >=60% held-out seeds

gates.name: butter_delivery_present
gates.threshold: butter delivery occurs on >=60% held-out seeds

gates.name: wood_stick_navigation
gates.threshold: pickup+delivery on >=60% stick seeds with normalized contacts no worse than no-optimize

gates.name: burning_match_route_avoidance
gates.threshold: route foraging succeeds on >=60% seeds while harmful heat occupies <=5% ant-ticks; entry is not required

gates.name: burning_match_forced_escape
gates.threshold: >=60% ants escape on >=60% forced-start seeds with harmful ticks no worse than no-optimize

gates.name: composite_performance
gates.threshold: pickup+delivery on >=60% composite seeds, pickup exceeds cold, hazards no worse than no-optimize

gates.name: matched_ablation_advantage
gates.threshold: paired bootstrap 95% CI lower bound >0 against cold, no-optimize, valence-off and segment-credit-off

gates.name: temporal_dynamics
gates.threshold: held-out behavior contains switches and at least one multi-step beta segment

gates.name: action_smoothness
gates.threshold: mean absolute turn delta <=0.55 rad per scenario

gates.name: checkpoint_archive_roundtrip
gates.threshold: fresh-session archive hydration succeeds and corrupt collection restore rolls back atomically

gates.name: runtime_replay_lineage
gates.threshold: frozen evaluation policy/temporal-learning fingerprints stay stable; eligible settlement and lineage >=0.99 with no drops

learned_mastery.threshold: pickups>=1, deliveries>=1 and hazard sample present
